verdict.rationale: AWS docs show generic resource lifecycle control—CloudFormation lets you delete a stack and all its resources, IAM lets you restrict who can access/delete data, and Resource Groups let you organize resources for management—which gives AI-native users some technical means to control retention/deletion of underlying cloud data. However, there is no evidence of AI-specific data retention/deletion policies (e.g., Bedrock model training opt-outs, conversation/log retention controls, or a dedicated privacy dashboard for AI workloads). missing for 10: explicit AI/ML data-retention policy docs (e.g., Bedrock data usage/opt-out), a unified deletion/retention control panel for AI data, independent verification of these controls in practice.
